declarations: Read on my own method only; no bracket field and no Valen flag is a reason (R1, R41).
pvp_*, bar_* and vwap_14d values are not in this packet; read from the W/D/H1 grid; successive value areas and volume nodes NOT_SERVED (R11).
My method carries no market-wide kill line; market_void null throughout.

answers.text: "A Creek bar is not a new high." True, and my method does not ask for one. C7: the preferred trend entry is the back-up to the broken Creek. D swing high 345.46 broken, high_20bar 363.95 printed 2026-11-05, close 345.76 back at the Creek, W and D HH/HL, H1 HL: that is the test, not a failure. The 363.95 high caps the first target (C14), not the entry. I would concede on a daily close back under the Creek.

decisions.wrong_if: Daily close under structure_shift_ref, or choch_bearish.
decisions.reason: TREND (W HH/HL, H1 HH/HL) but away from value: D close_vs_swing_high_pct 12.3. Do not chase (C3, C15); join at the test with a sign-of-strength bar (C7, C12).

decisions.reason: Fresh break at the test: D close_vs_swing_high_pct 0.89, D HH/HL, H1 pos_in_day_range_pct 100.0. Low-volume break is a potential upthrust until it holds (C5); the trigger requires follow-through (C12).
